nativeToJs.note: The only direction that fires window.__JUCE__.backend.addEventListener on the page.

pageLoaded.note: Emitted by the page on (re)load; the host closes open gestures and answers with syncAllParams.

valueConvention.value: ALWAYS normalised 0..1, the same scale AudioProcessorParameter::getValue() reports. Clamped by the native side before entering the APVTS.
valueConvention.real: Denormalised value in parameter units. Native -> JS only, informational.
valueConvention.text: Display text formatted by the parameter. Native -> JS only, informational.
valueConvention.gesture: JS -> native only: 'begin' opens a host gesture, 'change' continues it, 'end' closes it. Absent means 'change'. Unknown phases reject the message.

syncAllParams.sentWhen: Page (re)load, requestState, or host-side decision to resynchronise. Also the answer to a successful loadPreset (the load rewrote the whole state).

fields.version: Monotonic counter, incremented on every snapshot.
fields.parameters: Array of { id, value, real, text } in layout order, one per APVTS parameter.

parameterChanged.sentWhen: A parameter moved on the native side since the last report (value-diffed poll), or an external/automation change.

fields.id: Parameter ID as defined by the APVTS layout.

presetList.sentWhen: Answer to listPresets, a successful savePreset, or a successful loadPreset (after the state snapshot). Additive to protocol v1.

fields.presets: Array of preset names (strings), layout order of the preset backend.
fields.current: Name of the currently loaded preset (may be absent from presets).

presetError.sentWhen: A preset operation was rejected (unsafe name, no preset backend) or failed (not found, could not write). Never thrown; also counted in native stats.

fields.operation: The JS->native action name that failed: 'listPresets' | 'loadPreset' | 'savePreset'.

midiNoteState.sentWhen: Host poll of the plugin's external MIDI view (injected notes, hardware/DAW MIDI reaching the plugin). Additive to protocol v1.

fields.held: Array of held note numbers (0..127 integers).

parameterChanged.sentWhen: The user moved a control on the page, in any phase of a drag.

fields.id: Parameter ID as defined by the APVTS layout.

requestState.sentWhen: The page mounts, or wants a fresh full snapshot for any reason.

listPresets.sentWhen: The page mounts (with the requestState), or wants a fresh preset list. Additive to protocol v1.

loadPreset.sentWhen: The user picked a preset on the page.

fields.name: Preset name WITHOUT extension. Sanitised natively: no path separators, no '..', no control chars — a rejected name answers presetError. Success answers syncAllParams + presetList (gestures are force-closed).

savePreset.sentWhen: The user asked to store the current state under a name.

fields.name: Preset name WITHOUT extension, same sanitising as loadPreset. Overwrites an existing preset of the same name. Success answers presetList.

midiNoteOn.sentWhen: The user pressed a key on the page keyboard (shared @abdsynths/midi-keyb). Additive to protocol v1.

fields.note: Integer 0..127. Out of range or fractional: rejected (stats.midiRejected).

midiNoteOff.sentWhen: The user released a key (or the page panic released it).

midiPitchBend.sentWhen: The user moved the pitch wheel.

midiModWheel.sentWhen: The user moved the mod wheel.

midiPanic.sentWhen: The user pressed PANIC on the page: every sounding note in the plugin stops (page notes, hardware and DAW alike).

behaviour.echoSuppression: A value applied from JS marks the entry as reported; the native poller never echoes it back to the page that sent it.
behaviour.outgoingDelivery: Outgoing changes are POLLED via publishPendingChanges() (value-diffed), never pushed from parameter listeners. One message per changed parameter per poll.
behaviour.gestureLifecycle: begin opens at most one gesture per parameter; end closes it; a page reload closes every gesture the page left open (closeOpenGestures). An end without begin is tolerated and still writes the value.
behaviour.malformedInput: Malformed messages and unknown actions/ids are counted in stats, never thrown. Unknown parameter ids are counted separately from malformed messages.
behaviour.presetMessages: Preset messages are ADDITIVE to protocol v1: a page or host without them keeps working (unknown actions are counted, never fatal). Preset names are untrusted input: sanitised natively, failures answer presetError. A successful loadPreset closes open gestures, then answers syncAllParams + presetList; a successful savePreset answers presetList. When no preset backend is installed every preset action answers presetError.
behaviour.midiMessages: MIDI messages are ADDITIVE to protocol v1. JS->native actions are validated natively (note 0..127 integer, velocity 0..1, pitch -1..+1, mod 0..1); out-of-range fields count stats.midiRejected and never reach the engine. midiPanic takes no fields and stops every sounding note. Without a MIDI backend the actions are accepted and silently dropped. midiNoteState travels native->JS only: the page applies it with the keyboard feedback API (setPitchBend/setModWheel/notesOffVisual), which suppresses the echo of host-driven wheel moves.
behaviour.transportGuards: The native side MUST emit with emitEventIfBrowserIsVisible and MUST NOT call window.__JUCE__.backend.emitEvent from C++ (wrong channel direction, message silently discarded). Enforced by Tests/webviewBridgeDirectionTest.mjs.
behaviour.localMode: Without window.__JUCE__.backend the page keeps working with local state only; all sends are no-ops.
